name: Counter
description: Animated number counter where each digit rolls like an odometer wheel with spring physics, staggered timing, motion blur and fade masks. Supports locale formatting, prefix and suffix, and starts when scrolled into view.
contents: Inline number made of per-digit rolling wheels (0-9) and static symbols for separators, signs and currency
Screen-reader-only text with the formatted value, visual row hidden from assistive tech
Hidden measuring row and per-digit SVG blur filters
behavior: When value changes, each digit spins to its new digit with a spring (duration, bounce) and staggered start from the lowest place
Digits and symbols are added or removed with a width and opacity transition when the digit count changes
Roll direction follows value growth or shrink in auto mode, or is forced up, down or shortest
Vertical motion blur scales with digit speed
Top and bottom edges of each wheel fade out through a gradient mask
Intro spin plays once when the counter is at least 50% visible
Honors prefers-reduced-motion by jumping straight to the value
editableByProps: Number, locale, currency or percent formatting through format, fixed decimals, minimum digits
Roll direction, duration, bounce, stagger, motion blur, intro on or off
Font size, weight, color, digit gap, vertical padding, fade height, tabular widths
Extra classes and inline styles on root and digits

needsCodeEdit.where: IntersectionObserver threshold 0.5 in the intro useEffect
radius calculation in the paint function

fixed: Value must be changed by the parent through the value prop, the component has no internal counting or timer
Digit wheels always run 0-9 and the motion is spring-based, no easing choice
Intro spin is a full extra wheel turn triggered once by scroll visibility
Frame time step is capped at 1/20 s and uses requestAnimationFrame
Requires Tailwind CSS for the styling classes
Default font size is 100px, large for small screens, reduce fontSize on mobile
Client component using browser APIs, guarded for server rendering
